appTagline: Vintage cameras, film looks and pro edits
noFavs: Tap the heart on a look to save it here.
sampleNote: This is a sample photo. Drop a photo or video anywhere, or tap Open, to edit your own.
curveNote: Parametric tone curve. Push each tonal range up or down.
autoNote: Balances exposure, contrast and color in one tap.
retouchNote: Smooth skin only touches skin tones and keeps edges sharp.
neverDateNote: Remembered on this device. Looks that come with a date or overlay open without it.
dateLocked: Turn off "Never add a date" to use dates and overlays.
layerNote: Blends a second photo over yours, like shooting twice on one frame.
exportNote: Full resolution keeps every pixel of your original.
videoExportNote: Every frame is processed at full resolution and saved as MP4 with the original sound.
needsBrowser: Video export needs a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari
useMedia: Use a photo or a video file
heicNote: Could not open this HEIC photo. Export it as JPEG and try again.
webglError: This device does not support WebGL2, which ReyCam needs to render.
fallbackNote: Translation in progress, some text shows in English
noPresets: Save a preset from the toolbar to see it here.
cameraDenied: Camera access is blocked. Open Settings > Apps > Safari > Camera, choose Ask or Allow, then open ReyCam again.
cameraDeniedNative: Camera access is blocked. Open Settings > Apps > ReyCam and turn on Camera and Microphone.
micDenied: The microphone is off, so videos will have no sound.
cameraMissing: No camera was found on this device.
cameraBusy: The camera is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
cameraInsecure: The live camera needs a secure https:// address.
cameraUnsupported: This browser cannot open the live camera. Use Open to take a photo instead.
installNote: It opens full screen, works offline and keeps your presets.
installStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari. On iOS 26, tap ••• first, then Share.
installStep2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
installStep3: Keep Open as Web App on, then tap Add.
updateReady: A new version of ReyCam is ready.
saveImageHint: Tap Save, then choose Save Image to add it to Photos.
saveVideoHint: Tap Save, then choose Save Video to add it to Photos.
photosDenied: ReyCam cannot add to Photos. Open Settings > Apps > ReyCam > Photos and allow access.
exportLimit: Safari on this device saves photos up to {x}. This photo will be saved at {y}.
backupNote: Presets, favorites and settings are saved only on this device. Keep a copy in Files.
backupInvalid: This file is not a ReyCam backup.
storageKept: This device keeps your presets safe.
storageMayClear: Safari may clear data from sites you have not used for a while. Install ReyCam or keep a backup.
videoNoSound: Exported without sound because this browser cannot encode audio.
